transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before we finalize the communications annex this morning, I need to confirm a couple of things during our comms huddle. We have two portable relay kits available — Kit A and Kit B. Both the northern liaison site and the southern command post need a relay kit from 0800 through 1600 today. I want to verify equipment status on both kits and confirm there are no maintenance actions needed before I sign the annex and assign them. Has anyone identified any issues with either kit, or are there any changes to the site requirements I should know about?
